claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase — direct kind
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Create Food and Water has no attack roll and no saving throw. It is an instantaneous activation spell that directly produces an unconditional effect. The current ActivationPhase union only allows attack_roll | save_gate, making it impossible to represent a phase that simply fires an effect without a roll-gated branch.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of fresh water on the ground or in containers within range

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Effect — create_object kind
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's sole effect is conjuring physical objects (food and water) into the world. The v4 atom inventory includes create_object, but the surface Effect union only has damage | none. A CreateObjectEffect variant is required to represent this atom honestly.
